name: Trimpod Classic
description: An iPod Classic-inspired, offline music player for the TrimUI Brick/Hammer with winamp-like visualizations.
author: tyrannotorus

changelog.v1.0.10: Context menus gain Play and Add to Play Queue. Holding Power now powers off the Brick.
changelog.v1.0.9: Indexing shows a Scanning Library progress screen instead of a blank screen. Adding or removing a library folder reindexes immediately. Launch after a library change no longer stalls for ~15 s.
changelog.v1.0.8: Audiobook support for .m4b files: each book resumes from where you left off, and L2/R2 skip between chapters.
changelog.v1.0.7: Added Themes with Dark, Light, and a third ink variant per color. Volume bar now reads 'Volume X/40'. Fixed: playlist song menu not sliding back on close, status bar showing '.trimpod_queue', divider line ignoring the foreground color, and Now Playing spacing/status-bar text alignment.
changelog.v1.0.6: Fixed music playing about 8% too fast (roughly 1.4 semitones sharp). USB-C headphones work again, with in-app volume control. Powering off a Bluetooth speaker no longer crashes the app. Unplugging headphones or losing a Bluetooth device now pauses playback instead of switching to the internal speaker.
changelog.v1.0.5: Fixed bug allowing user to escape to file system after song end
changelog.v1.0.4: Rebuilt the audio output path: direct ALSA output with a hardware/software split volume. Fixes quiet passages dropping to silence at low volume; maximum volume is now full scale.
changelog.v1.0.3: Adjusted volume increments, improved performance by reducing redundant cycle burn, added a controls legend to Settings, various bug fixes.
